title: Witboost Edit Template (v2)
description: Schema for edit-template.yaml files. Edit templates define which fields of an existing entity can be modified after creation. They reference the creation template(s) they apply to via useCaseTemplateId and use 'ui:disabled: true' to lock fields that should not be changed (name, domain, parent system, identifier, development group).

description.description: Description of what this edit template allows to modify.

icon.description: URL to the icon. Usually the same as the creation template.

tags.description: Tags. Convention: include 'edit' tag plus the creation template's tags.

owner.description: Owner of this edit template (group or user).

useCaseTemplateId.description: Array of creation template URNs this edit template applies to. When a user edits an entity created with one of these templates, this edit form is presented.

parameters.description: Array of wizard pages. Same structure as creation template parameters. Fields that must not be editable should have 'ui:disabled: true'. The first page is typically an informational page (title + description only, no properties) explaining what can and cannot be edited.

title.description: Title displayed at the top of this wizard page.

description.description: Help text. On the first page, typically explains what can/cannot be edited and what files require manual updates. Supports markdown.

properties.description: Form field definitions. Fields with 'ui:disabled: true' are shown but not editable.
